verdict.rationale: Runloop repeatedly markets Devboxes as 'secure sandboxed execution environments' and documents adjacent security controls (network egress policies, encrypted secrets, SSH end-to-end encryption), but none of the evidence specifies the actual isolation mechanism — no mention of microVMs, Firecracker, gVisor, hypervisor-level isolation, or any technical architecture describing a hard boundary between sandboxes and host/tenant systems. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the isolation technology (microVM or equivalent), any architecture diagram or security whitepaper describing tenant separation, and independent verification of the isolation boundary's strength.
